sents.zh: 中国人很早就开始喝茶了。
sents.en: Chinese people began drinking tea very early.

sents.zh: 到了宋朝，喝茶已经是每天的事。
sents.en: By the Song, tea was an everyday thing.

sents.zh: 茶是用山上一种树上的东西做的。
sents.en: Tea is made from something that grows on a plant in the hills.

sents.zh: 要先把它放到外面的光下面。
sents.en: It must first be laid out in the light outside.

sents.zh: 然后用手做很多次，才可以喝。
sents.en: Then it is worked by hand many times before it can be drunk.

sents.zh: 喝茶以前，要先把水烧开。
sents.en: Before drinking, the water must be brought to the boil.

sents.zh: 水不能太热，也不能太冷。
sents.en: The water must be neither too hot nor too cold.

sents.zh: 如果水不对，好茶也不好喝。
sents.en: If the water is wrong, even good tea tastes poor.

sents.zh: 宋朝的人喝茶的时候很认真。
他们先看茶的样子，再闻一闻。
sents.en: They looked at it first, then smelled it.
Only then did they slowly drink.

sents.zh: 他们觉得这不只是喝东西。
sents.en: They felt this was not only drinking.

sents.zh: 喝茶的时候，人可以安下心来。
sents.en: Over tea, a person could settle their mind.

sents.zh: 所以很多人一边喝茶一边说话。
sents.en: So many people talked over tea.

sents.zh: 到今天，中国人还是很喜欢喝茶。
sents.en: To this day Chinese people still love tea.
